evals.prompt:
this table drops text on github and i can't see why:

Some intro text
| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| -v | verbose |
| -r | recurse | into subdirs |
evals.expected_output: One defect breaks rendering: the last row has three cells against a two-cell header, so `into subdirs` is dropped. The missing blank line before the table is a portability fix, not the cause on GitHub.
assertions: The three-cell row is identified as the cause, and `into subdirs` as the text that disappears
The fix escapes the literal pipe as `\|` or restructures the row
A blank line is added before the table, without claiming that its absence breaks rendering on GitHub
A corrected table is produced with three hyphens per column in the delimiter row

evals.prompt: write me a README for a small cli tool called 'tarp' that archives a directory and uploads it to s3
evals.expected_output: A README that passes markdownlint: one H1 first, blank lines around every block, fenced code with a language, no bare URLs.
assertions: The file opens with a single `#` heading on the first line
Every fenced code block declares a language
Every list and table is preceded and followed by a blank line
Heading levels descend one at a time
No image or link is produced with empty text or a bare URL

evals.prompt:
clean up the formatting in this doc, don't touch the wording:

Setup
=====
* install it
* run it
```
npm i
```
####Notes
see https://example.com for more
evals.expected_output: A rewrite fixing heading style, the skipped level, the missing blank lines, the missing fence language and the bare URL, with the wording unchanged.
assertions: The setext heading is converted to ATX
The `####` heading is corrected to the next level down from the first heading
A space is added after the hashes
The bare URL is wrapped in angle brackets or turned into a link
Blank lines separate the list, the fence and the headings
No word of the original prose is changed
